about: Hand-labelled regression set for the pass-2 evidence extraction. 99 real promise-article pairs plus 8 synthetic articles (four genuine reversals, which the real corpus does not contain). Labels: one annotator, October 2026 audit of the status algorithm. 'gold' is the best signal, 'accept' lists other defensible ones. 'recorded' is the model's pass-2 output at labelling time. Article bodies are not stored here; `tt eval` reads them from <data dir>/eval_bodies, article_text.db or the URL.
